theme_and_archetype.domain: B2B SaaS / Wine Distribution (Tierra Nuestra Huelva)
theme_and_archetype.primary_archetype: Archetype 5: Jewel & Luxury (mixed with Archetype 4 for data density)
theme_and_archetype.vibe: Sophisticated, Old-paper sommelier notebook (Light), Refined wine cellar (Dark). Premium, fast, data-dense.

fonts.display_headings: Cormorant Garamond (Used for Login, AI headers, Presentation mode titles)
fonts.ui_headings: Manrope (Used for Dashboard widgets, Product Cards, Modal titles)
fonts.body_data: IBM Plex Sans (Used for Data tables, dense descriptions, form inputs)

scale_and_rules.body: text-sm text-base for reading, text-sm for dense UI

rules.ai_elements: Use Accent (#D4AF37 / Gold) to highlight AI buttons and AI recommendations.
rules.glassmorphism: Use sparingly on Sticky Headers or Product Quick Views (Dark: bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-xl border-white/10). No muddy transparency.

layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: Generous spacing for headers/containers (p-6, p-8). Tight spacing for data grids (gap-4).
layout_and_spacing.main_layout: Sidebar navigation (collapsible) + Topbar (Global search, Theme Toggle, Cart toggle) + Main Content Area.
layout_and_spacing.filter_rail: Horizontal scrollable pill section below Topbar for quick wine types (Tinto, Blanco, Rosado, Espumoso, Generoso).
layout_and_spacing.dashboard_grid: Bento Grid style (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4) with 1px border cards, tight gaps, flat solid backgrounds.
layout_and_spacing.product_catalog: Grid (cards) and List (dense rows) toggle. Each item must show name, winery, denomination, grapes, 4 price tiers.

components.global_search: Command palette style or large prominent top bar input with deep integration for barcode scanning.
components.barcode_scanner: Button with Lucide camera icon embedded in the search bar. Activates modal with scanning UI.
components.price_slider: Shadcn Dual-range slider customized with Primary (Bordeaux) color track.
components.ai_assistant: Floating Action Button or prominent Sidebar item. Clicking opens a side panel 'Claude Sonnet 4.5' chat UI for alternative recommendations and sales arguments.

shopping_cart_sidebar.fields: Commercial dropdown (Fernando, Ernesto, Tienda), Client Name input, Observations Textarea.
shopping_cart_sidebar.actions: Export PDF, Send via Email (tnh@tierranuestrahuelva.es), Send via WhatsApp (+34699414559).

components.product_card: Minimalist, thin borders. Use nested radii. Wine bottle image left/top. Clear typography for winery and pricing tiers.
components.login_screen: Split screen: Left side beautiful vineyard/cellar imagery, Right side elegant login form using Cormorant Garamond headers.
components.presentation_mode: A toggle that hides navigation and simplifies the UI to focus entirely on the product being presented to the client, using the generated luxury backgrounds.

media_and_icons.icons_library: lucide-react (Default for crisp UI) and @phosphor-icons/react (for luxury duotone icons on marketing/login).

bordeaux_abstract_bg.description: Generated abstract bordeaux fluid texture. Use for Presentation Mode background or Dark Mode Login screen.

sommelier_paper_bg.description: Generated elegant textured off-white paper. Use for Light Mode Login screen or Presentation Mode.

wine_cellar_dark.description: Wine bottles arranged on a rack. Can be used for empty states or dashboard banners.

sommelier_pouring.description: A man pouring wine. Can be used for the AI Assistant's avatar/welcome state.

instructions_to_main_agent.file_extensions: USE ONLY .js AND .jsx FILES. NO TYPESCRIPT (.ts/.tsx).
instructions_to_main_agent.data_testid_rule: MUST add data-testid attribute to ALL buttons, inputs, form submissions, filter pills, cart actions.
instructions_to_main_agent.routing: Ensure routing has private paths. Login -> Dashboard (Comparative) | Catalog | Order History.
instructions_to_main_agent.state_management: Use standard React Context or Zustand for Cart, Theme, and Commercial User session.
instructions_to_main_agent.shadcn_customization: Heavily customize shadcn config in tailwind.config.js to map to the color_palette colors exactly (primary, secondary, accent, background).
instructions_to_main_agent.pdf_export: Implement an elegant HTML to PDF library (like html2canvas/jspdf or standard window.print()) styled for professional invoices.
